description.value:
Brand color: primary buttons, links, selected states. Light themes: brand 600 (emerald 700) with white text; dark themes: brand 400 with brand-950 text. More contrast: brand 800 / brand 300, 7:1+ on `surface` and `primary-subtle`.

`var(--blue-600)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--primary)`.

Hover / pressed state of `primary` (one step darker in light themes, lighter in dark). More contrast: brand 900 / brand 200.

`var(--blue-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--primary-hover)`.

Brand tint for selected rows and badges (brand 50 light, brand 950 dark).

`var(--blue-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--primary-subtle)`.

Text and icons on `primary` fills (white in light themes, brand 950 in dark).

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--on-primary)`.

Secondary button fill; hover fill for outline and ghost buttons.

`var(--zinc-100)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--secondary)`.

Hover state of `secondary`.

`var(--zinc-200)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--secondary-hover)`.

The keyboard-highlighted item in a list: Menu items, Combobox and TimePicker options, the Sidebar's current page. One step stronger than `secondary` in light (about 1.3:1 on `surface`); in dark it shares `secondary`'s zinc-700 (1.7:1 on `surface`, 1.4:1 on `surface-overlay`), so a `primary` bar keeps 3:1 on it in every brand, paired with a 2px `primary` bar at the item's start. Text on it keeps 4.5:1.

`var(--zinc-200)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--highlight)`.

The fill while a row, tab, day or page button is held down (`:active`): one step past its hover. `text` keeps 7:1+ on it.

`var(--zinc-300)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--pressed)`.

Page and card background (white light, zinc-900 dark).

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--surface)`.

Secondary panels, sidebars, table headers.

`var(--zinc-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--surface-muted)`.

A raised card (Card `elevated`). One step up from `surface` in dark, where a shadow doesn't show.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--surface-raised)`.

Anything in the top layer: Menu, Popover, Dialog, Drawer, Toast and the Combobox, DatePicker and TimePicker lists.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--surface-overlay)`.

Background of text inputs, selects and other form fields.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--field)`.

Background of a read-only or disabled form field: a step flatter than `field` (zinc-50 in light, the page's zinc-900 in dark), so it reads as not editable while its `field-border` still outlines it.

`var(--zinc-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--field-readonly)`.

Border of form fields. 3:1+ against `field` and `surface` in every theme, as WCAG 1.4.11 requires for a control's boundary.

`var(--zinc-500)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--field-border)`.

Field border on hover.

`var(--zinc-600)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--field-border-hover)`.

Placeholder text in form fields (4.5:1+ on `field`). Placeholders are hints, never labels.

`var(--zinc-500)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--placeholder)`.

The dimmed backdrop behind dialogs and drawers (zinc-900 at 50% in light themes, zinc-950 at 70% in dark).

`#18181b80` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--overlay)`.

Contrasting blocks: tooltips, inverse banners.

`var(--zinc-900)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--surface-inverse)`.

Body text and headings on `surface`.

`var(--zinc-900)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text)`.

Secondary text, captions, placeholders (4.5:1+ on `surface` in every theme).

`var(--zinc-500)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-muted)`.

Text on `surface-inverse`.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-inverse)`.

Default borders and dividers.

`var(--zinc-200)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--border)`.

Emphasised dividers and outlines. Form fields use `field-border`, which meets the 3:1 a control boundary needs.

`var(--zinc-300)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--border-strong)`.

A raised card's edge: invisible in light (white on white), a 1px lighter edge in dark.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--border-raised)`.

The edge of a top-layer surface. In dark it is one step stronger than `border`, so a menu stands off the page.

`var(--zinc-200)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--border-overlay)`.

Keyboard focus outline, in the brand hue (3:1+ on `surface` in every theme). More contrast: brand 700 / brand 300.

`var(--blue-500)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--focus-ring)`.

Success icons and fills (3:1). For success text use `success-text`.

`var(--green-600)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--success)`.

Success alert / badge background.

`var(--green-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--success-subtle)`.

Success text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `success-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

`var(--green-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--success-text)`.

Warning icons and fills; put dark text on it. For warning text use `warning-text`.

`var(--amber-600)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--warning)`.

Warning alert / badge background.

`var(--amber-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--warning-subtle)`.

Warning text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `warning-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

`var(--amber-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--warning-text)`.

Errors, destructive buttons; white text on it (4.8:1). For error text on dark surfaces use `red-400`.

`var(--red-600)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger)`.

Hover / pressed state of `danger`.

`var(--red-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger-hover)`.

Text and icons on `danger` fills.

`var(--white)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--on-danger)`.

Error alert / badge background.

`var(--red-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger-subtle)`.

Destructive text and icons on `surface`, `danger-subtle` and its hover (5.3:1+ in every theme).

`var(--red-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger-text)`.

Hover fill for destructive secondary, outline and ghost buttons.

`var(--red-100)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger-subtle-hover)`.

Border of a destructive outline button.

`var(--red-300)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--danger-border)`.

Informational icons and text.

`var(--sky-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--info)`.

Info alert / badge background.

`var(--sky-50)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--info-subtle)`.

Info text on `surface`, `surface-muted` and `info-subtle` (4.5:1+ in every theme).

`var(--sky-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--info-text)`.

A visited link in reading content (Prose): a shade apart from primary, 4.5:1+ on `surface` and `surface-muted` in every theme.

`var(--violet-700)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--link-visited)`.

Pure white.

`shadow-2xs`. Hairline lift under flat controls.

`0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-2xs)`.

`shadow-xs`. Buttons and inputs (Button uses it).

`0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-xs)`.

`shadow-sm`. Cards at rest.

`0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-sm)`.

`shadow-md`. Raised cards, hover states.

`0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-md)`.

`shadow-lg`. Dropdowns, popovers.

`0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-lg)`.

`shadow-xl`. Dialogs, floating panels.

`0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-xl)`.

`shadow-2xl`. Modals, the highest elevation.

`0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-2xl)`.

`shadow-none`. Removes a shadow.

`0 0 #0000` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--shadow-none)`.

`inset-shadow-2xs`. A hairline inner edge.

`inset 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--inset-shadow-2xs)`.

`inset-shadow-xs`. Inputs and wells.

`inset 0 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--inset-shadow-xs)`.

`inset-shadow-sm`. Pressed or recessed areas (was `shadow-inner`).

`inset 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--inset-shadow-sm)`.

`inset-shadow-none`. Removes an inner shadow.

`inset 0 0 #0000` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--inset-shadow-none)`.

`text-shadow-2xs`. Crisp edge on small text over images.

`0px 1px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-shadow-2xs)`.

`text-shadow-xs`. Text over busy backgrounds.

`0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-shadow-xs)`.

`text-shadow-sm`. Headings over photos.

`0px 1px 0px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075), 0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075), 0px 2px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.075)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-shadow-sm)`.

`text-shadow-md`. Large display text.

`0px 1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-shadow-md)`.

`text-shadow-lg`. Hero text.

`0px 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 3px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0px 4px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1)` in blue-light. Use it as `var(--text-shadow-lg)`.

`text-shadow-none`. Removes a text shadow.
